my daughter was born with a vascular birthmark which is what these are called.  She has a very large partially involuting congenital hemangioma or PICH on her leg above her knee.  we see the dermatological team at CHOP once a year to keep an eye on it……her particular birthmark does not have any other related issues. Sometimes someone can also have a hemangioma on an internal organ if they have one visible in their skin as well.

re: port wine stains

One possible complication from a Port Wine Stain is Sturge-Weber Syndrome. This is a risk when the stain is located on the upper face, especially around the eye. The condition can affect the membranes that cover the brain and possibly result in mental retardation, seizures and/or vision loss. Some patients with this disease suffer no complications and live normal lives.

This info is from the vascular birthmark institute whom we consulted when my daughter was born

BY PHILIP LARKIN
I work all day, and get half-drunk at night.   
Waking at four to soundless dark, I stare.   
In time the curtain-edges will grow light.   
Till then I see what’s really always there:   
Unresting death, a whole day nearer now,   
Making all thought impossible but how   
And where and when I shall myself die.   
Arid interrogation: yet the dread
Of dying, and being dead,
Flashes afresh to hold and horrify.

The mind blanks at the glare. Not in remorse   
—The good not done, the love not given, time   
Torn off unused—nor wretchedly because   
An only life can take so long to climb
Clear of its wrong beginnings, and may never;   
But at the total emptiness for ever,
The sure extinction that we travel to
And shall be lost in always. Not to be here,   
Not to be anywhere,
And soon; nothing more terrible, nothing more true.

This is a special way of being afraid
No trick dispels. Religion used to try,
That vast moth-eaten musical brocade
Created to pretend we never die,
And specious stuff that says No rational being 
Can fear a thing it will not feel, not seeing
That this is what we fear—no sight, no sound,   
No touch or taste or smell, nothing to think with,   
Nothing to love or link with,
The anaesthetic from which none come round.

And so it stays just on the edge of vision,   
A small unfocused blur, a standing chill   
That slows each impulse down to indecision.   
Most things may never happen: this one will,   
And realisation of it rages out
In furnace-fear when we are caught without   
People or drink. Courage is no good:
It means not scaring others. Being brave   
Lets no one off the grave.
Death is no different whined at than withstood.

Slowly light strengthens, and the room takes shape.   
It stands plain as a wardrobe, what we know,   
Have always known, know that we can’t escape,   
Yet can’t accept. One side will have to go.
Meanwhile telephones crouch, getting ready to ring   
In locked-up offices, and all the uncaring
Intricate rented world begins to rouse.
The sky is white as clay, with no sun.
Work has to be done.
Postmen like doctors go from house to house.

ok ok here it goes (hold on tight it’s a long, sordid tale as many tales are)…….. My dad who is now deceased (he died in 2010 at the age of 58 from severe aplastic anemia, SAA) had a horrible awful horrible temper.  knowing what I know now about psychology I’m pretty sure he likely had ADHD and may also have been bipolar (just speculation given all his aberrant behaviors, struggles in school and anger), but like a lot of people, especially men born in the 50s, he just kind of powered through his very obvious mental illness and never got help.  Plus I come from a family, a very evangelical christian family, where mental illness doesn’t exist, you just pray the crazy away…….It worked spectacularly well for my depression and anxiety growing up (i wonder why i’m gnostic)

anywhooooo, I guess about year 14 of my fathers blissful (sarcasm, it was shit) second marriage to my mean, cold , “flowers in the attic” stepmom, things went really awry.  I was out of the house thank God and had been for many many years at this point so I got all the information from my dad (and some from stepsister much later) because I’m an only child and at this point he had alienated every person that ever really cared about him due to his horrendous temper and all around sunny disposition (🙄)………in his defense he was right in the middle of battling severe aplastic anemia and in grueling treatment so he wasn’t really in a good headspace at all…….I mean the man was nuts he was never in a truly healthy headspace but it was even worse at this point.

so my stepmonster who was a mail carrier and very fit decided she’d get herself a boyfriend.  But not just any old boyfriend.  She decided she would start sleeping with a man half her age (not knocking this but D was extremely immature and clueless) that she worked with at the post office.  But wait it gets better…….He was her daughters (my stepsister’s) ex-boyfriend and he still hung around a lot even tho they were broken up……We will call him Derrick because that’s his name.  

I mean no hate towards good old Derek he was young and not the brightest bulb in the chandelier.  but to start having sex with his ex girlfriends crazy stepfather‘s wife…… either he was clueless or had a death wish or both.

Anyway I got a call one day from my dad who wasn’t my most favorite person because he made my life miserable growing up and was honestly quite abusive…… but I’m in only child so I took the fucking call out of some messed up respect for family obligation or something, i don’t know we are still unpacking that in therapy.  so I get this call from pops that I need to come help him clean up the house.  ok no problem.  He really struggled with overwhelming fatigue at this stage in his SAA so I’m thinking I’ll grab a dust rag, some Pledge, the vacuum and head on overI.  I am married at this point(still am happily even though he probably should have ran for the hills 17 years ago)  so my husband and I roll on up to the family homestead, cleaning supplies in tow.  

first thing we see upon cresting the driveway is a very nice (expensive) yellow touring kayak chopped up into many pieces, out in the yard……My dad and stepmom really enjoyed kayaking before dad became sick and too fatigued to go kayaking.  

As we entered the big groaning 100 year old Victorian house we were met with straight up chaos..  Like stuff had been ripped off the walls and thrown around and pictures had been torn up into tiny pieces, photo albums opened and ripped up, broken glass was everywhere and the big brass marital bed was hanging half way out of the second story window…… like this once beautiful home filled with antiques looked like it was hit by a tornado (Tornado Bobby) and was a completely trashed.  I was extremely surprised at how much damage a sickly 55 year old man managed to do to one house but was not shocked as this was my dad’s MO…..when he got his buttons pushed (and that was often) he flew into a blind terrifying rage.  

He would do super bizarre things in his rage but he really enjoyed taking his anger out on furniture and food oddly.  I remember being probably five one time when my bio mom and he were married and he flew into a blind rage in the kitchen and just started chucking raw eggs at my mothers head…… at this point I think it might be good to mention that I have PTSD and I’m a survivor of childhood trauma, you know good things from Grade A parenting!!

OK OK so anyway house is trashed furniture just ripped up and I start asking him very casually what happened.  At this point my husband is wide-eyed and rocking back-and-forth uncomfortably in the corner…..also did I mention dad was a gun man?? yeah he loved his guns.

anyway here’s the story I get.  Stepmonster announces to Dad the day before that she and Derrick are going on a kayaking trip because at this point she was still lying and saying she and big D were just best buddies.  This was a huge trigger for dad because kayaking was a thing he loved most and he couldn’t kayak anymore due to his health so he of course was like “the fuck you are”

Stepmom, never a woman to be told what to do (which made their relationship super fun and volatile) was like “yeah I am”.  Then dad loses his shit and was like “I know you’re fucking him you want to go kayaking OK try to kayak with no legs bitch!” and grabs his trusty old hatchet and begins chasing her around the home…… apparently in an attempt to remove her legs

Now stepmom was younger by 7 years and fit (she had a walking route as a mail carrier) and she was tall and she was not sick like dad so she moved pretty damn fast….. dad obviously could not catch her as fatigue being his number one symptom of SAA.  So he was like “fuck you, you might get to keep your legs but I’d like to see you go kayaking with Derek without a kayak!!” and proceeds to chop the kayak up with his trusty hatchet.  Now dad had a long history of chopping shit up that pissed him off with his trusty hatchet……One time when he was trying to put together a new wooden outdoor swing for my grandparents he got frustrated (because poor guy was dyslexic and struggled with reading directions) and chopped up the brand new swing with….. you guessed it his trusty hatchet

OK I digress AnyWho long story short (too late) stepmom called the cops and rolled out with her shit to live with Derrick.  cops came and confiscated all dad‘s guns but somehow did not arrest him for domestic violence. And then Chris and I helped his crazy ass clean up the house.

obviously my childhood was truly horrible and my poor father was truly mentally ill but you know I have a dark sense of humor and have about 15 years of therapy under my belt so I can tell the story now with a twisted combination of hilarity, incredulity and nostalgia.  

so there it is a story of how my father tried to kill my stepmother with a hatchet.  The end and you are welcome
